title: Chapter 137: Pair of Eyes
html:
“ Pei Hu!”

As Chen Ge reattached the mannequins’ heads, a man’s scream echoed from the far end of the corridor. It carried a complicated mixture of emotions.

That isn’t ordinary fear. I hear surprise, anger, and terror.Chen Ge finished the last mannequin and left the classroom. This group certainly has energy.

…

Inside Room 303, Pei Hu pressed his back to the door, cold sweat covering his forehead.

“Damn, Wenlong is still in the well.” Pei Hu stared at Wenlong’s phone in his sweaty hand. “And I took his light. It’s pitch-black down there, with mannequins buried underneath.”

He dared not pursue the thought. Room 303 retained its original appearance, including a heap of dirty clothes in the center, though the stench was gone.

“Why leave clothes in the middle of the floor? This room gives me the creeps. I’ll stay by the door.” The moment he finished muttering, something knocked behind him—from a point near his feet.

“No person knocks that low. That isn’t Wenlong.” Apart from his friend, only one other thing moved through the corridor. Pei Hu stared at the bottom of the door as his face fell. “It’s the mannequin’s head. The head is knocking!”

His knees weakened. When he reached for the lock, he discovered it was decorative; the slightest push would open the door.

“There should be a window, but the head will enter as soon as I leave the door.” Nor could he stand there blocking it forever. Each knock reverberated through his skull. “I need another way out.”

Pei Hu searched the apartment, stepping over the dirty clothes, but found no escape. “A concrete wall blocks the window. Am I trapped until the game ends?” Standing in the living room, he despaired. “How did a Haunted House visit become this? A winking mannequin, bodies under the well, and a severed head that chases people. Is the owner a magician?”

Before Pei Hu could get an answer, there was a loud bang on the door.

“Why did it get stronger? Did the mannequin find her head?” The thought chilled him. In desperation, he fled into the bedroom.

“Why doesn’t the bedroom have a door?” He regretted entering, but it was too late. The only hiding place was beneath the bed. After checking the darkness with the phone’s light, he crawled under.

Please leave me alone.He pocketed the phone and fixed his gaze on the doorway. In the dark silence, every sound grew enormous. Seconds later, the living room door opened. After a tense pause, a faint noise crossed the floor.

Something is rolling across the floor…A second later, cold swept from his feet to his scalp as a realization struck. I forgot something!

The sound approached. When Pei Hu looked toward the doorway, the smiling mannequin head rolled into view and stopped.

Their eyes met, and time seemed to stop.

…

Wang Hailong led Xia Meili and Dou Menglu into the girls’ dormitory. Though he had cried earlier, he had to appear brave before his girlfriend. He walked ahead, checking each room until they reached the Pen Spirit’s.

“This room is different.” Several chairs surrounded a sheet of paper. Brother Long picked it up and read aloud. “The Pen Spirit knows the locations of three name tags.”

“No wonder it looks familiar. It’s the Pen Spirit game.” Curious, Dou Menglu came closer. “I’ve seen it in movies, but never expected to encounter one in real life.”

“It’s fake—a gimmick.” Wang Hailong tossed the paper down. “But we can’t ignore three tags. Do either of you know the rules?”

“I do.” Dou Menglu sat on one of the chairs and had Wang Hailong sit beside her. “Just follow my lead.”

“Could you be more cautious? Playing this inside a Haunted House might attract something.” Xia Meili remained at the door, uncomfortable as she watched Dou Menglu flirt with Wang Hailong.

“If a Pen Spirit appears, even better. I’ll ask whether I’m destined to become Brother Long’s wife.” Grinning, Dou Menglu picked up the pen bound with clear tape.

“Go ahead.” Wang Hailong took her hand, ignoring Xia Meili’s presence. Pouting, Xia Meili turned away. “Enjoy yourselves. I’ll look around.”

“Don’t wander too far, Meili.”

“She knows how to take care of herself. Now, listen to me, Brother Long, there are several taboos to the Pen Spirit game. One, you mustn’t ask about death; two, you cannot stop the game abruptly…”

The air seemed fresher once Xia Meili left. That room reeks of cloying romance. I hope the Pen Spirit teaches them a lesson.

The farther she went, the more oppressive the corridor became. She was about to turn back when Wang Wenlong screamed somewhere ahead.

What happened? He sounds more furious than frightened.Xia Meili retraced her steps and entered the other corridor.

Where are they? Another junction? Which way?She stopped between the path to the old well and the Hai Ming apartments. Pei Hu lost his phone. I’ll call Wenlong.

A ringtone sounded from one of the apartments, but no one answered.

Are they inside one of these rooms?The ringtone sounded unnaturally eerie. Xia Meili ended the call and approached the three doors.
